correction_boundary.r1_5_epoch0_no_update: superseded as a scientific negative; retained as evidence of selection and optimization failure
correction_boundary.r1_5_h3_zero_gradient: superseded as a biological H3 result; it is a structural-zero instrument failure
correction_boundary.r1_6_minimal_h3: no support in six E384 cells; only two independent validation units, so this is not a biological absence claim
correction_boundary.r1_6_t1: E384 is development robust support; Chengshuai and Chenziyang are optimizer-sensitive; E1096, Zhangjiaqi, and Zhangkexuan are current-model generalization/nonidentifiability results

diagnostic_explanations.epoch_zero: R1.5 compared alignment updates with a checkpoint already refit on the selection tail; R1.6 uses disjoint 0-60%, 60-80%, and 80-100% chronological TRAIN partitions
diagnostic_explanations.zero_gradient: the old epoch-0 T1 has exactly zero state_timing, state_contact, and state_size weights, so the H3 edge derivative at zero is exactly zero
diagnostic_explanations.zero_selected: gradients and training improvement are nonzero, but the chronologically later selection block chooses epoch 0

scope: development optimizer/trainability diagnosis; not a cohort H1-H3 acceptance and not a formal-test result

early_stopping.reason: synthetic positive seeds can first improve near epoch 100; use frozen module budgets and chronological selection

h3_policy.note: H3 learning rate cannot repair an exact-zero downstream derivative

target_alignment.selection: fit TRAIN first 80%; select on TRAIN last 20%; refit full TRAIN
